_readme: THE ARCHIVE run. An ART example, not a row from the catalogue (Jon, 2026-09-30): the idea from three summers ago. Everything on the phone is rendered from this file. 'rest' is the stock Voice Memos list. 'query' is typed into the Audio Dex search. 'results' are recordings the system named by what it heard. 'moment' is the one opened: 'trim' the kept seconds, 'window' the stretch the waveform shows, 'peaks' its bars, 'hits' where the word lands in the whole recording, 'assigned' what each tool wrote onto the file. 'src' stays null unless a clip plays.

results.title: guitar on the porch, the good chorus
results.line: Two people working out a song on acoustic guitar; the chorus lands on the third pass and they play it back twice.

results.title: hummed chorus idea, walking home
results.line: A melody hummed over traffic, the chorus repeated four times so it isn't forgotten.

results.title: kitchen, singing over the dishes
results.line: Someone sings a chorus while washing up; water running, a laugh at the end.

results.title: rehearsal, the bridge into the chorus
results.line: A band runs the bridge into the chorus six times, arguing about where the drums should drop out.

results.title: piano sketch, chorus chords only
results.line: Four chords cycled on an upright piano, a chorus with no words yet.

results.title: voice memo to self, chorus lyric
results.line: A single chorus lyric spoken quickly, then 'okay, don't lose that.'

moment.said: wait, play that again. that's the chorus.
